title: Hamel-based TVG Stronger than the Usual Topology on R
summary: For every nonzero rational-valued additive functional on the real line, we construct a Hausdorff nondiscrete topological vector group topology strictly finer than the usual topology. We prove that two such topologies coincide exactly when their coefficient functionals differ by a nonzero real rescaling; every other pair is incomparable. The family contains as many distinct topologies as there are subsets of the real line. Their supremum is still nondiscrete and strictly finer than every individual member.
